annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Model Risk Management: Observations from a Thematic Review
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Model Risk Management: Observations from a Thematic Review
annotation.summary_en: MAS information paper presenting good practices in AI and generative AI model risk management observed in a mid-2024 thematic review of Singapore banks, covering governance, AI inventories, risk materiality, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, generative AI and third-party AI. Applicable to other financial institutions; supervisory guidance is under consideration.
key_provisions_or_claims: Banks set up cross-functional AI oversight forums and update policies and principles on fair, ethical, accountable and transparent AI use.
AI inventories and risk materiality assessments (impact, complexity, reliance) calibrate proportionate controls.
Independent validation for higher-materiality AI; peer review for lower-materiality AI.
Pre-deployment checks, monitoring with thresholds, change management, and kill switches for critical AI.
Generative AI is limited to human-augmenting uses with human-in-the-loop, guardrails and third-party AI controls; MAS considering supervisory guidance.
